assumptions: Unit-edge-squared-length-two regular simplices, random Haar discarded subspace, integer k_m/log(m) approaching a strictly positive finite constant.
integrity: Self-contained proof of the asymptotic reduction and overlap inequality. Finite checker reproduces identities but is not an infinite-dimensional certificate.
scientific_limitations: Only convergence in probability for logarithmic discarded codimension; fixed and larger regimes are outside this claim. Relevant older originals are inaccessible and independent priority checking remains necessary. First-public-date is a verified date of the source arXiv v1, not the date of the result.
title: A sharp logarithmic-codimension diameter law for Haar projections of regular simplices
